name: agent-tool-assistant
description: AI Agent 工具调用助手 (LangGraph + OpenAI Function Calling)

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python3.11 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
